activities.caption: drag between play and practice
activities.name: ltadPlayCompare

before.label: Deliberate play
before.text: varied, fun, self-organised games building general coordination — broadly the 6–12 buffet.

after.label: Deliberate practice
after.text: structured, specific, effortful — entering meaningfully in adolescence, once the general base exists to build on.

config.why: A child's sporting diet should look like a buffet, not a prescription — the base is ordinary, varied, self-organised play.

statements.s: The rule tells six-year-olds to specialise now.
statements.why: It was misread — the original research described expert practice in already-selected adult musicians.

statements.s: The original research studied already-selected adult musicians.
statements.why: The pop-culture retelling dropped the broad base and the counter-evidence.

statements.s: Early specialisers show more overuse injury and burnout, not more senior champions, in most sports.
statements.why: The evidence runs against the myth — with narrow early-technical exceptions.

statements.s: Quality and variety beat raw volume for the developing athlete.
statements.why: The misreading made volume the point; the framework makes the developmental map the point.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — how the pyramid sorts
activities.name: ltadTalentSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary is wrong — click it:
lines: Mass participation at the base; clubs and districts narrowing to the elite apex.
Access factors decide who enters the funnel at all.
Age-banded selection skews squads toward early-year births.
The funnel runs on talent detection — scouts snapshot ability and pick.
Good systems keep late developers in and select late.
config.correction: The funnel sorts by birthday and circumstance — hence the shift from talent identification (a snapshot) to talent development (an environment).
config.why: Good systems deliberately keep late developers in the funnel, because early prediction is barely better than the birth-month lottery.

activities.caption: walk both careers to the crossing
activities.name: ltadSwimmersBranch

config.root: One pool, a pair of careers. Ana starts club squads at seven; by nine she trains six mornings a week with stroke technique drilled every session. Ben starts at nine, swims twice a week, and keeps football, tennis and athletics going.

start.text: By twelve, Ana wins every age-group final; Ben is an also-swam. What does the sampling research predict comes next?

choices.label: Ana's stardom fades; Ben's general base and appetite carry him through
Ana's early hours convert into senior dominance

mis1.text: That is the hours myth — at fourteen the curves cross: her shoulders have grown faster than her stroke has adapted.

cross.text: What does the growth-spurt mismatch do to Ana?

choices.label: Times plateau, the sport feels like a job — she stops at fifteen with an overuse shoulder
Her technique adapts to the new levers and she speeds up

mis2.text: Coordination temporarily worsens while levers lengthen; skills re-consolidate only after, under managed load.

ben.text: And Ben? A proper squad at fifteen — general movement base, no injury history, appetite intact — and the hormone window at sixteen meets a trained athlete waiting for it.

config.why: Early stardom that fades, late bloomers who persist — what the sampling research predicts and age-group trophy selection keeps failing to see.

activities.anchor: Strip the branding from the successful talent-development environments
activities.caption: pair each academy practice with its reason
activities.name: ltadAcademyMatch

config.prompt: Pair each academy practice with the reason it recurs:

pairs.right: the decisive variable in pathway studies is the quality of coaching interactions, not the kit
early prediction is barely better than the birth-month lottery
school and sport timetables designed together protect both the exit and the entry
workload registers that actually modulate training — the institutional pitch-count
the athlete who is also a student, a musician, a friend exits better — and often performs better

config.why: None of it is expensive; all of it is cultural — federations with modest budgets regularly out-develop richer ones.
